name: Isaac
self_text: I'm Isaac, a Korean man in my mid 20s. Outside of gaming, I've been spending my time learning to sail because I love the feeling of the wind. On my PC, these days it's all Hollow Lantern for me. I'm mostly into ranked matches, where I usually end up in a damage role. I'm available most weeks on Sunday afternoon and I'm on either text chat or voice chat during my sessions. In terms of coaching, I am looking for someone to coach me.

requests.request_text: I'm searching for a gaming partner, and you have to be into Skyforge Arena. I'd strongly prefer that you are into ranked matches, though it's not a requirement.
I need you to be into Skyforge Arena. I'd strongly prefer that you are into casual matches—which is a change from my usual preference for ranked matches—though I won't rule you out over it.
this_time: This time: casual matches. Usually: ranked matches.
